CI runs `flake8 . --count --statistics --config .flake8` (generated/.github/workflows/pythonapp.yml:27). generated/.flake8:2-4 selects E-codes and generated/.flake8:6-19 does not ignore E127, so this line would fail the lint job. This was determined by measuring columns and was not executed.
